title: Configuration center
intro: Manage this deployment. Changes apply to everyone using it.
siteNameHint: Shown in the Web navigation. Up to 60 characters.

cleanupHint: Every 15 minutes, remove sessions and verification records expired over 24 hours ago, and rate limits older than an hour.
jobsAvailable: Scheduling is enabled in this deployment. This setting applies to the next run.

reload: Load latest and keep my edits
forbidden: Only a deployment administrator can manage this site.

conflict: Another administrator changed these settings. Load the latest version before saving; your edits are still here.
deploymentHint: Database connections, the deployment encryption secret and initial administrator setup are managed by the operator.
closedHint: Use an invitation link from a Space owner to create an account.
